briefdescription.para: Prints the banner, one line at a time, to stdout.
Writes one error line to stderr: the project name, the argument, and the message.

parameterdescription.para: The argument that the error concerns.

briefdescription.para: Writes the project name, the version, and the build commit to stdout.
Tells whether stdout is a terminal.

simplesect.para: true when stdout is a terminal.

briefdescription.para: Prints the banner and the help text to stdout.

detaileddescription.para: The help text is the binary resource files::lingHelp.

memberdef.definition: static const jam::Function::Map< juce::Identifier, jam::Function::pointerCapacity, int()> & getFlags
memberdef.name: getFlags

briefdescription.para: Returns the table of flags that run without a document: the version and the help.

detaileddescription.para: The table is built on the first call. Each entry runs its action and returns the exit code of the run.

simplesect.para: A reference to the static table.

briefdescription.para: Appends one report row for a document: its path, its declaration count, and its reference count.

detaileddescription.para: An element with the declaration role is a declaration. Every other element is a reference.

parameterdescription.para: The text that receives the row.

briefdescription.para: Prints the banner and the help text, then reports the path as not found on stderr.

parameterdescription.para: The path that was not found.

briefdescription.para: Resolves a manifest argument against the current working folder, then follows a link to its target.

parameterdescription.para: The index of the manifest argument. It is flagArgIndex for a manifest run, and postFlagArgIndex for an operation run.

briefdescription.para: Returns the word of a flag argument, without its double dash.

detaileddescription.para: The double dash test is kept in this one function, so each caller follows the same rule. An argument without a double dash has no flag word.

simplesect.para: The text after the double dash, or an empty view when the argument has no double dash.

briefdescription.para: Returns the toolchain argument that follows the manifest argument, without its double dash.

detaileddescription.para: The double dash test is made by getFlagWord. An argument that does not start with a double dash is not a toolchain argument.

parameterdescription.para: The index of the manifest argument.

simplesect.para: The toolchain argument text, or an empty view when the next argument is not one.

briefdescription.para: Tells whether the arguments name a manifest, with or without a toolchain argument.

simplesect.para: true for one argument, or for two arguments whose second argument is a toolchain argument.

briefdescription.para: Runs the version or the help flag, reports a manifest as not found, or reports an unknown flag.

detaileddescription.para: The flags table selects version and help. A manifest argument, with or without a toolchain argument, goes to the not-found report. Any other command line with more than one argument prints the unknown flag error for the argument after the manifest, or for the argument after its toolchain argument. With no argument, the function prints the banner and the help text.

simplesect.para: EXIT_SUCCESS for the version, the help, or no argument, or EXIT_FAILURE for a not-found file or an unknown flag.
